source: Gattinoni L, Caironi P, Cressoni M, et al. Lung recruitment in patients with the acute respiratory distress syndrome. N Engl J Med 2006; 354(17):1775-1786; Amato MB, et al. Driving pressure and survival in the acute respiratory distress syndrome. N Engl J Med 2015; 372(8):747-755.
claim: In a recruitable lung at fixed tidal volume, lung recruitment from raising PEEP from 5 to 14 cmH2O (+9 cmH2O) lowers driving pressure, causing plateau pressure to rise significantly less than one-for-one with PEEP (Pplat <= 25.5 cmH2O), in contrast to a non-recruitable lung where Pplat rises one-for-one with PEEP to 29.0 cmH2O.
